Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <Pine.SOL.3.90.1010828150120.18936B-100000@bohm>, ....salem
christ.... <s940...@bohm.anu.edu.au> writes

>can you use temptation more than once in a turn?

No. It uses a "During X, Do Y" template for each of its abilities
(master phase considerations, minion phase considerations).

During X, Do Y means *once* During X, Do Y.

Excuse me, but where is it noticed on the card that we must have at
least one counter to trigger it ? Following official card text, from
WW website :
Temptation
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Serpentis
[ser] (D) Put this card on a ready vampire; you still control this
card. During your master phase, you may put a temptation counter on
this card. During your minion phase, if the number of counters on this
card equals or exceeds the amount of blood on that vampire, you may
burn all the <counters> on this card to untap that vampire and take
control of him or her until the end of your turn.
[SER] As above, but put a counter on this card when you put it on the
vampire.

IMHO, I think it is possible to burn zero counter to take control of a
bloodless Vampire... LSJ ?

François
